shots.x: A black stain crosses the milk-white water faster than a man can run; fish turn white and float up behind it.
shots.vo: The first thing the ocean gave them was not the prize.

shots.x: Both armies drop the rope and run along the shore, gods and demons mixed together in the same direction.
At the edge of the water a fisher child stays where she is, one hand held out toward the dark.
The black water reaches her feet and goes round them, and does not touch her.
